title: docs/05-test/verifier-verdicts.json
description: What a cross-family verifier must return for a verifier-route envelope. verifier-route.mjs (checkVerdict) is the executable version of this file: it also resolves every evidence citation against the excerpts the verifier was actually shown, which a JSON Schema cannot express.

envelopeHash.description: The hash of the envelope this verdict answers. A mismatch means the verdict answers a different task.

model.description: The verifier's model id. Required unless `family` is given; one of the two is required so independence is judgeable.

family.description: The verifier's model family, if it does not want to disclose the exact model. Must differ from the author's family.

verdict.description: The overall verdict, when the answer is not broken down per claim. Per-claim answers take precedence.

claims.description: One entry per claim in the envelope. A claim left unanswered invalidates the verdict.

evidence.description: Required for confirmed and refuted. Each entry is <path>:<line> (or <path>:<from>-<to>) naming a file and a line that appear in the envelope's excerpts.

missing.description: Required when verdict is insufficient: the single fact that would settle the claim.
